fields.audience: Parents and guardians of Cedar Heights Elementary students
fields.subject: Measles exposure at Cedar Heights Elementary School
fields.body:
A person with measles was at Cedar Heights Elementary School on October 17 and 18 between 7:30 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. Measles is very contagious and can cause serious illness, especially in young children.

The health department is working with the school to identify students and staff who may not be protected.
actions: Check your child's vaccination record for two doses of MMR vaccine.
Students without proof of immunity must stay home from October 23 through November 8, even if they feel well.
If your child develops fever or rash, call before visiting a clinic.
